title: Greeting, No Other Gospel, Paul Called by God

questions.question: Paul asserts he is an apostle—not from men nor through man, but through whom?
options: Jesus Christ and God the Father
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus Christ and God the Father
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:1 (ESV): "Paul, an apostle—not from men nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—"

questions.question: Lord Jesus Christ gave himself for our sins to deliver us from the present ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:4 (ESV): "who gave himself for our sins to deliver us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,"

questions.question: Paul is astonished that they are so quickly deserting him who called them in the grace of Christ, and are turning to a ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:6 (ESV): "I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—"

questions.question: Not that there is another one, but there are some who trouble you and want to ____ the gospel of Christ.
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:7 (ESV): "not that there is another one, but there are some who trouble you and want to distort the gospel of Christ."

questions.question: What does Paul say should happen if even an angel from heaven should preach a gospel contrary to the one they preached?
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:8 (ESV): "But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be accursed."

questions.question: Paul asks, "Am I now seeking the approval of man, or of God?" If he were still trying to please man, he would not be a ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:10 (ESV): "For am I now seeking the approval of man, or of God? Or am I trying to please man? If I were still trying to please man, I would not be a servant of Christ."

questions.question: Paul certifies that the gospel he preached is not man's gospel. How did he receive it?
options: Through a revelation of Jesus Christ
Through the Holy Spirit at Pentecost
questions.correctAnswer: Through a revelation of Jesus Christ
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:11-12 (ESV): "For I would have you know, brothers, that the gospel that was preached by me is not man's gospel. For I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it, but I received it through a revelation of Jesus Christ."

questions.question: Paul reminds them of his former life in Judaism, how he ____ the church of God violently and tried to destroy it.
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:13 (ESV): "For you have heard of my former life in Judaism, how I persecuted the church of God violently and tried to destroy it."

questions.question: He was advancing in Judaism beyond many of his own age, so extremely ____ was he for the traditions of his fathers.
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:14 (ESV): "And I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my own age among my people, so extremely zealous was I for the traditions of my fathers."

questions.question: But when he who had set him apart before he was born, and who called him by his grace, was pleased to reveal his Son to him, why did he do this?
options: In order that I might preach him among the Gentiles
To show the Jews their error
To establish the church in Rome
So that he might suffer for his name
questions.correctAnswer: In order that I might preach him among the Gentiles
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:15-16 (ESV): "But when he who had set me apart before I was born, and who called me by his grace, was pleased to reveal his Son to me, in order that I might preach him among the Gentiles..."

questions.question: After his revelation, Paul says he did not immediately consult with anyone, nor did he go up to Jerusalem. Instead, where did he go?
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:16-17 (ESV): "...I did not immediately consult with anyone; nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia, and returned again to Damascus."

questions.question: Then after how many years did he go up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas and remain with him fifteen days?
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:18 (ESV): "Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas and remained with him fifteen days."

questions.question: Paul says he saw none of the other apostles except who?
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:19 (ESV): "But I saw none of the other apostles except James the Lord's brother."

questions.question: Then he went into the regions of Syria and ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:21 (ESV): "Then I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia."

questions.question: The churches of Judea only heard it said, "He who used to persecute us is now preaching the ____ he once tried to destroy." And they glorified God because of him.
questions.explanation: Galatians 1:23 (ESV): "They only were hearing it said, 'He who used to persecute us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.'"

key_verse_text: For am I now seeking the approval of man, or of God? Or am I trying to please man? If I were still trying to please man, I would not be a servant of Christ.
